plainText:
This is a list of themes that have been played in the dub of the Pokémon animated series. The fourth, fifth, and sixth movies were released only with voice-overs, eighth, ninth, and tenth movies haven't been translated at all, while wasn't dubbed past its first season. However, Master Quest and Advanced openings were left in English.

==Openings==

The fourth, fifth, and sixth movies were released only with voice-overs, eighth, ninth, and tenth movies haven't been translated at all, while wasn't dubbed past its first season. However, Master Quest and Advanced openings were left in English.
